name: Behavior-preserving refactor
description: Improve structure or readability while preserving the current contract and proving that behavior stayed stable.

outcomes.description: The targeted code has a simpler structure or clearer ownership without feature expansion.
Characterization and regression checks confirm the existing behavior remains intact.

prerequisites.description: The current behavior and public or internal contract are understood well enough to characterize.
prerequisites.check: Record inputs, outputs, errors, and side effects before editing.

prerequisites.description: The refactor can stay inside a sibling file scope without changing a neighboring contract.
prerequisites.check: Inspect active lanes and name the exact relative scope.

lanes.objective: Capture the current contract and a representative regression baseline.
Reshape the implementation mechanically while leaving behavior and interfaces stable.
Run characterization, relevant suite checks, and a final behavior comparison.

qualityGates.description: Representative behavior is recorded before the implementation is reshaped.
The diff changes structure and naming without adding a new feature or hidden behavior.
Regression checks pass and the last known-good integration point remains identifiable.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; prepare context without typing or recording the secret.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Change billing, account security, destructive data, or live financial behavior during a refactor.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: A refactor should be behavior-preserving and safely testable.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Preserve the characterization baseline and return to the last known-good integration point if behavior differs.
rescueSteps: Capture the before and after check summaries.
Keep the refactor diff isolated from feature work.
Abandon the lane when the contract cannot be explained.
stopConditions: The current contract is not observable.
A proposed change alters behavior or scope.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit credentials, tokens, private paths, and personal data.
Summarize behavior without copying sensitive payloads.
